2958.title: ACP model option families
2958.rootCauseOneLine: ACP-native discovery maps every model option directly and bypasses the existing suffix-family builder; ACP registration also advertises Fast for all agents.
2958.proposedFix: Share the variant-family resolver with native discovery and define how agents publish dynamic Fast support.
2958.caveats: The reproduction used the trusted catalog function. It did not download or run an external ACP server.
